title: Unavailable candidate new method requests/responses; not gen1 fixture replacement
description: Actor/caller/invocation authorization lives in transport, never params. Errors feature-local. Byte/scalar/permission/graph/CAS constraints are normative semantic checks.

invoke.description: Actor/caller from authenticated transport, never JSON params. Registered action schema validates input; opaque to host. <=64KiB UTF-8 JSON.

journalAppend.description: Owner invocation lease required. Host atomically stamps immutable attribution, digest, operation receipt and deferred delivery manifest; append defaults pinned. <=64KiB charged payload including manifest.

deferred.description: RFC6901 pointer within this append's opaque JSON, must resolve to bounded object. Host computes/stamps digest and original actor under current send grant.

deliveryIntent.description: Host-produced immutable evidence. Recovery accepts cursor/index only, never caller replacement sender/body/digest.

mailboxEnvelope.description: Opaque payload; host never treats consumed as task acceptance. Registered offline/unknown addresses may queue held without wake; retired cannot newly enqueue.

claim.description: Atomic waiting-version CAS and exact recipient execution; expiry is not run failure or permission for automatic replay. Human read never starts Pi run.
